title: Mollifier approximation of a C¹ test field by smooth fields with supports in a fixed compact subset of U and uniformly convergent derivatives
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, U ⊆ E open, and X a test field in U (X : E → E is C¹, has compact support, and tsupport X ⊆ U). Then there are a compact set K with tsupport X ⊆ K ⊆ U and maps Y_k : E → E (k ∈ ℕ) such that each Y_k is C^∞ with compact support and tsupport Y_k ⊆ K, and DY_k → DX uniformly on E as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (X : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsOpen U → IsTestField U X → ∃ (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (Y : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ tsupport X ⊆ K ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k ↦ fderiv ℝ (Y k)) (fderiv ℝ X) atTop
